answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow bond: each identity locks 40 credits and files a 14-point sonnet of timing, counterparties, jobs, cipher-sealed on the dune log. Auditors recompute the sonnet from the cipher log each epoch; drift past the dune line freezes it, and a copied fingerprint burns it and pays the challenger. Faking one costs 40; the k-th 40+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 and lock 40,000 for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 40 once.
